propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan in activated project criteria to Pass 1 discovery, prevent new evidence or coaching in Pass 3, or route findings through repository-aware resolution.

Project routing can describe a code-review criterion but evaluation and CLI resolution remain plan-review-biased with a closed prompt set, and Pass 3 does not consistently apply one repository-effective routing view.

Four-phase separation (discover → assess → decide → coach) is eroded when finder refines severity, verifier invents issues, decision depends on LLM, or coach re-adjudicates, collapsing productive tension and hiding policy changes.

A generic core defect maps logical `project.<name>` ids to validator-safe physical `code-review-project-<name>` ids and must complete dynamic fan-in, repository-effective Pass-3 routing, project eval/CLI resolution, and compatibility coverage.
